- If possible, please have someone who can speak to architecture (KV-cache/quantization choices) and someone who can cover outcomes (cost/latency metrics).

Agenda suggestion (30–45 mins):
1) 5m intros
2) 15m architecture + deployment discussion
3) 10m outcomes & metrics
4) 10m Q&A and next steps on case study rights/quote
